items.information:
### 🇳🇴 Teknostallen 2026

Gjør deg klar for en fin kubehelg når vi inviterer til konkurranse i Teknostallen i Trondheim 28.–29. mars! Dette blir en helg med ekte konkurransestemning, offisielle tider og masse energi. Arrangementet er for ALLE – enten du løser kuben på 3 sekunder eller 3 minutter, og enten du er 7 eller 70 år. Her skal både nybegynnere og erfarne speedcubers samles for å dele lidenskapen for kuben og jakten på nye personlige rekorder.

Konkurransen går over to dager inne i den spektakulære tropiske hagen i Teknostallen, en helt unik ramme for raske fingre og raske hoder. Det konkurreres i mange ulike grener, fra klassisk 3x3 til flere andre varianter. Dette blir en helg fylt med mestring, spenning og ekte kubeglede.

Man går inn hovedinngangen på Teknostallen, og venteområdet kommer til å være under messaninen, mens konkurransene foregår oppe på messaninen. Det er gode muligheter for å kjøpe både mat og drikke fra de ulike plassene på bygget som Mellom, Glød og Snurr. 

---

### 🇺🇸 Teknostallen 2026

Get ready for a great cube weekend as we invite you to a competition at Teknostallen in Trondheim on March 28–29. This will be a weekend filled with real competition atmosphere, official timing and plenty of energy. The event is for EVERYONE – whether you solve the cube in 3 seconds or 3 minutes, and whether you are 7 or 70 years old. Both beginners and experienced speedcubers will gather to share their passion for cubing and the pursuit of new personal bests.

The competition takes place over two days inside the spectacular tropical garden at Teknostallen, a truly unique setting for fast fingers and fast minds. Multiple events will be held, from the classic 3x3 to several other variations. Expect a weekend filled with achievement, excitement and true cube joy.

Enter through the main entrance of Teknostallen. The waiting area will be located under the mezzanine, while the competitions take place on the mezzanine level. There will be great opportunities to purchase food and drinks from the various venues in the building, including Mellom, Glød and Snurr.

Данелия дерлік естімейді, сөйлеуі қиын, бұл оның жалпы дамуына әсер етуде. Қазіргі таңда ол сүйек өткізгіштігі бар есту аппаратын қолданады, алайда ол жиі бұзылып, баланың белсенді өміріне төтеп бере алмайды. Биыл Данелия 5 жасқа толады, және медициналық көрсеткіштер бойынша оған бас сүйегіне имплантация немесе каналопластика операциясы қажет.
АҚШ дәрігері ұсынған каналопластика операциясы Данелияның есту қабілетін қалпына келтіріп, есту жолын кеңейтуге және өмір бойы есту аппаратына тәуелді болмауға мүмкіндік беруі мүмкін.

Жарыс  Алтын сауда орталығында ,3 қабаттары  холлда өтеді.
Сіздің қолдауыңыз Данелияға толыққанды өмір сүруге үлкен үміт сыйлайды.
Баршаңызды қайырымдылық жарысына қатысуға және қолдау көрсетуге шақырамыз

English:
The competition is organized for charitable purposes. All funds raised during the event will be directed toward the treatment of Danelia, who has been diagnosed with congenital bilateral ear atresia and microtia.
Danelia can barely hear and has difficulty speaking, which affects her overall development. Currently, she uses a bone-conduction hearing device; however, it frequently breaks down and cannot withstand an active child’s lifestyle. This year, Danelia turns 5 years old, and according to medical indications, she requires either a skull implantation procedure or canaloplasty surgery.
The canaloplasty surgery recommended by a U.S. doctor may help restore Danelia’s hearing, widen the ear canal, and allow her to live without lifelong dependence on a hearing device.
The collected funds will not be handed directly in cash. All donations will be officially received through the «ZHALAIRI» charitable foundation and will be legally and transparently allocated to Danelia’s treatment.
The competition will take place at Altyn Shopping Center, 3rd floor hall.
Your support gives Danelia great hope for a full and happy life.
We invite everyone to participate in the charity competition and show their support.

## Participants and Spectators under 18
* Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
* Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

All additional donations and remaining profits from this competition will go towards supporting West Coast Cubing and the Cal Cube Club.

## Please read the "What is a Favorites Competition?" tab before registering.

## Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may bring a maximum of two guests.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
